'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]]
**[[October 2024 Israeli strikes on Iran]]
***[[Israel]] launches airstrikes against [[Iran]], with [[explosion]]s reported in [[Tehran]] and [[Karaj]] according to [[Mass media in Iran|Iranian state media]]. Four [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|soldiers]] are killed. [https://news.sky.com/story/iran-several-explosions-heard-in-capital-tehran-state-tv-reports-13241460 (Sky News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/explosions-heard-irans-capital-tehran-nearby-karaj-semi-official-iranian-media-2024-10-25/ (Reuters)] [https://www.axios.com/2024/10/25/israel-attacks-iran-retaliation (Axios)]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] says that it is carrying out "precise strikes on military targets in Iran" in response to recent [[ballistic missile]] attacks launched from Iran. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2024/10/26/israel-iran-live-air-strikes-retaliates/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese Civil War]]
**[[2024 eastern Gezira State massacres]]
***At least 300 people are killed when the [[Rapid Support Forces]] attack several villages in [[Gezira State]], [[Sudan]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/10/26/at-least-124-killed-after-sudan-s-rsf-attack-village-activists-say (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency]]
**Ten [[police officer]]s are killed by [[Jaish ul-Adl]] gunmen in a [[mass shooting]] on a [[Law Enforcement Command of the Islamic Republic of Iran|police]] convoy in [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-police-shooting-sistan-baluchestan-province-8e1ea2c0c73606ffd189eb97efaaf05d (AP)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**An [[improvised explosive device|IED]] planted by [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] in a restaurant in [[Karan district]], [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], kills at least five people and injures at least five others. [https://thesomalidigest.com/al-shabab-ied-attack-in-mogadishus-karan-district-claims-5-lives/ (''The Somali Digest'')] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2024/Oct/198651/landmine_explosion_in_mogadishu_s_karaan_district_kills_three_civilians.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**The death toll from the [[flood]]ing and [[landslide]]s caused by [[Tropical Storm Trami (2024)|Tropical Storm Trami]] in the [[Philippines]] increases to at least 126. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2024/10/26/world-philippines-flooding-landslides/8911729964059/ (UPI)]
*Nineteen people are killed and five others are injured when a bus crashes on a highway in [[Zacatecas]], [[Mexico]], while heading from [[Nayarit]] to [[Ciudad Juárez]], [[Chihuahua (state)|Chihuahua]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/two-dozen-people-die-central-mexico-bus-crash-2024-10-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Killing of Odair Moniz]]
**[[Polícia de Segurança Pública|Portuguese police]] activate special security protocols in response to two large [[political demonstration|demonstrations]] in [[Lisbon]] following the fatal shooting of a [[Cape Verde|Cape Verdean]] immigrant by a police officer in [[Amadora]] on Monday, which resulted in widespread [[riot]]s. [https://www.rtp.pt/noticias/pais/manifestacoes-em-lisboa-psp-ativou-protocolo-especial-de-seguranca_v1610405 (RTP News)]
*A [[Russia]]n soldier throws a grenade and shoots at other soldiers, killing ten people near [[Novopokrovka, Polohy Raion, Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Novopokrovka]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/russia-soldier-kills-10-comrades-own-unit-1976379 (News Week)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Georgian parliamentary election]]
**[[Georgians]] vote for the 150 seats of the [[Parliament of Georgia|parliament]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqj0l8rpvelo (BBC News)]
**Opposition parties refuse to accept early results indicating the ruling [[Georgian Dream]] party's victory, and accuse it of [[election fraud]]. Exit polls published by pro-government and pro-opposition TV channels show each camp leading respectively.
